note: This file is the DECLARED grant matrix in machine-readable form. It exists so that three things can be compared and must agree: the migration SQL that writes the grants, this declaration, and the LIVE catalogue of a store built from the migrations. tests/test_grant_matrix_declaration.py compares the first two by parsing the SQL. A register check compares this file against the live catalogue; that check is deliverable B1 and is not in this increment. This file states obligations, never results — nothing here records whether a check passed.

default_privileges.reason: Schema private carries no table in WO-2 because what is book-adjacent is product meaning (PBG-AUTH-005). The boundary is built now so the first such table arrives inside it. This is the ONLY default privilege in the store.

invariants.statement: cd_engine holds no privilege of ANY kind on schema witness or on any object in it.
routes_that_must_all_be_checked: direct grant on the schema (information_schema.usage_privileges / pg_namespace.nspacl)
direct or column-level grant on a table (information_schema.table_privileges, information_schema.column_privileges, pg_class.relacl)
a grant to the pseudo-role PUBLIC that cd_engine would inherit
membership of another role that holds such a grant (pg_auth_members, transitively)
a default privilege that would grant it on a future object (pg_default_acl)
ownership of the schema or any object in it (pg_namespace.nspowner, pg_class.relowner)
the SUPERUSER or BYPASSRLS role attributes (pg_roles)
invariants.why: A check that only looks for a direct GRANT catches the instance and not the class. Assurance is instructed to attack the other six routes.

invariants.statement: cd_witness MAY SELECT publication.public_envelope, and holds nothing on raw.* or dial.*. The valve is one-way.
No role holds UPDATE, DELETE or TRUNCATE on dial.history, raw.observation, witness.observation or alert.event — nor, in this implementation, on any table in the six schemas.
invariants.note: TRUNCATE is included deliberately: a matrix that forbids DELETE and permits TRUNCATE forbids nothing.

invariants.statement: cd_public holds SELECT on exactly two tables — publication.public_envelope and publication.witness_panel — and holds nothing on dial, raw, private or publication.private_envelope.
cd_review holds no INSERT or UPDATE on any dial or envelope table, and publication.review declares no numeric dial column for a headline to be written into.
Every one of the six roles is NOSUPERUSER, NOCREATEDB, NOCREATEROLE, NOINHERIT, NOREPLICATION, NOBYPASSRLS, and is a member of no other role.
No application role owns a schema, table, sequence or function. Every object is owned by the migrator role.

disclosed_deviations.implemented_as: INSERT on raw.source_registry, raw.observation, raw.reading only.
disclosed_deviations.reason: Those two tables did not exist when the matrix was written; they hold BLUEPRINT §5's declarative DISPOSABLE constraint. Granting a collector INSERT on a dial's required-input set would let a collector decide what a dial requires, contradicting the same section's 'no collector holds a grant that would let it write a conclusion'. Raised to the Project Lead rather than resolved here.
disclosed_deviations.if_ruled_otherwise: two GRANT lines in a new forward migration

disclosed_deviations.observation: BLUEPRINT §4's schema table says schema dial is 'readable by cd_engine, cd_private', but the grant matrix row for cd_engine lists only SELECT on raw.* and INSERT on dial.*. The grant matrix is implemented as written, so cd_engine holds no SELECT on dial.history.
disclosed_deviations.consequence: Consistent with evaluate() being a pure function of its arguments — the engine does not read its own history. Raised so the Project Lead can reconcile the two halves of §4 before WO-3 needs it.

disclosed_deviations.observation: BLUEPRINT §4's schema table says alert.* is readable by 'cd_private, health endpoint', but the grant matrix names no role for the health endpoint and cd_public's row says 'everything else' is absent. No health-endpoint grant is created.
disclosed_deviations.consequence: The health surface (CD-AC-014, BLUEPRINT §10) has no store role in WO-2. Raised to the Project Lead.
